nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Strength Peptide Barrier Boost Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide

segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone reviewers mostly report the moisturizer keeps their skin matte and hydrated without clogging pores, though one reviewer with a history of acne broke out on her cheeks after about a month of use.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including those in dry climates, widely report deep, lasting hydration, though one reviewer felt it wasn't quite enough on its own for very dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, generally report no irritation and a calming effect on their skin, though one felt it didn't do much beyond the basics.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it hydrates without adding heaviness or shine, including one with cystic acne-prone combination skin who found it lightweight and non-clogging.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging report firmer, more hydrated skin after use, with several recommending it specifically for older or maturing skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and softer fine lines within one to a few weeks, though at least one reviewer noticed no improvement in elasticity, firmness, or strength.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, across skin types, describe the moisturizer as deeply and lastingly hydrating, though a few say it didn't feel hydrating enough or wasn't sufficient alone for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who mention redness, including several with rosacea, report the moisturizer calmed their skin, with no dissenting reports.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the moisturizer with helping repair or strengthen their skin barrier, describing calmer, more resilient skin after consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts and some say it works well on acne-prone skin, but two reviewers, including one who doesn't usually break out, report new breakouts after about a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report it keeps their skin matte rather than shiny, though one reviewer noted it felt a little oily on the skin immediately after application.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable citrus or floral scent, not universally loved
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Good value, a little goes a long way
Jar packaging without a pump seen as less hygienic
Considered pricey for the amount received

extraits.titre: Don't use if you've dealt with acne
extraits.texte: After a month of using it, I started breaking out on my cheeks. Prior to using this I was using korean skincare and never had this problem.. Just be aware of possible breakout if you have acne prone skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very satisfied with this product. I have rosacea, and a dry and sensitive skin, so I'm always looking for a product that is hydrating but gentle on my skin. I am also turning 30, so I have been trying to find creams with ceramides and peptides in them, which I believe will support better my skin. This moisturizer worked so well for me. I started using it when my rosacea was having a flare, and it helped my rosacea to calm down. I also felt a difference when I started using it every night for a couple of weeks. My skin felt firmer and more hydrated. The reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because it has a strong scent. I usually don't mind scent in my skincare as long as it is not too much, but this one is strong and I didn't like it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's a pretty good moisturizer, but for me it's only going to be for those months where the weather is warmer. Because on its own, during the colder months, it's too lite to do a good job as a skin barrier. But if used as a base with a thicker moisturizer on top then it shouldn't be a problem. However, I'm not one to apply two moisturizers. It does go on smooth, has a nice scent (reminds me if raspberry lemonade), and absorbs super fast. But again, for my skin it only hydrates well when the weather is warmer. Unfortunately though, I did not see any signs of improvement to my skin regarding elasticity, firmness, and strength. I also would prefer that it came in a tube or a pump rather than just a jar. Overall, it's a good product.

extraits.titre: Makes my skin so dewy and radiant
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this brands skincare especially the eye cream and now I'm in love with this moisturizer. If my skin could talk it would say this moisturizer is made for my skin. I have cranky oily to combo very cystic acne prone skin and this moisturizer is so lightweight and dewy and moisturizing. I have been using it morning and night since I received it and my skin looks so radiant and happy and glowing. I'll be repurchasing it over and over. Love the packaging too very simple and practical.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Ole Henriksen peptide boost moisturizer has a light, uplifting citrus scent and it instantly hydrates. The peptides and ceramides have helped with my fine lines and have firmed my skin after just a couple uses. I use this moisturizer morning and night and it layers well under SPF and makeup. I recommend this moisturizer to anyone with mature skin.

extraits.titre: Super hydrating moisturizer that makes my skin feel soft
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this moisturizer for a little while now, and it's been excellent for my dry skin. The texture is thick and creamy, yet it doesn't feel greasy once absorbed. My skin typically feels tight after cleansing, but this moisturizer keeps it hydrated all day and especially overnight. I also noticed my skin appeared smoother and more refreshed in the morning. It works well under makeup and didn't cause any pilling with my other products. A little goes a long way, so the jar should last a while. If you prefer lighter moisturizers, it might feel a bit heavy initially, but for dry or dehydrated skin, I think it works really well. I didn't experienced any irritation or stinging while using it.
